limitations: Public web/news uses GDELT DOC 2.0 (public query API) and optional official NewsAPI. Google News HTML/RSS is not fetched because robots.txt disallows /rss.
Article bodies are not scraped. Title/description plus source URL and publication date are retained.
Country is set only when the source supplies geography. English language is not treated as South Africa.
NewsAPI UNAVAILABLE until NEWS_API_KEY is configured.
